day_shape: 54 items: UK/Canada/Australia joint statement condemning Israel closing the WCK convoy probe, IDF strikes in south Lebanon and Gaza, Pezeshkian and Ghalibaf respond to fresh US sanctions, UK teenager pleads guilty over Iran International arson.

threads.label: WCK convoy case closed, allies protest
threads.summary: The UK, Canada and Australia issued a joint FCDO statement on Israel's decision to close the investigation into the 1 April 2024 strikes on the World Central Kitchen convoy. Poland separately summoned Israel's ambassador in Warsaw over the ending of criminal proceedings for the death of aid worker Damian Sobol.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said Givati Brigade troops shot a Palestinian who crossed the Yellow Line in southern Gaza, and the air force struck a building in Baraashit, southern Lebanon, after suspects entered it. The military also announced the killing in a Wednesday Nuseirat strike of Hamas platoon commander Sobhi Sami Mahmoud Shahtot, linked to 7 October hostage-taking.

threads.label: Tehran responds to new US sanctions
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian said Iran should end the war while in a "position of power" and vowed not to bow to bullies, while Speaker Ghalibaf called for plans to overcome "unjust sanctions" following fresh US measures. The Jerusalem Post reported Iranian crude supplies to China tightened this week under a US blockade, and IRIB cited UKMTO figures showing Strait of Hormuz vessel traffic at 4% of pre-conflict levels.

threads.label: UK arson case at Iran International
threads.summary: A 19-year-old British man pleaded guilty at a London court to an arson offence linked to the April attack on offices connected to Iran International in northwest London. A teenage co-defendant denied the more serious charge of arson being reckless as to whether life was endangered.

threads.label: Iranian military and defence messaging
threads.summary: Iran's army naval commander said the enemy would not be permitted to approach Iranian soil, Brigadier General Shahrokh Shahram said production of powerful weapons continues without pause, and acting defence minister Abn al-Reza addressed Friday prayers in Tehran on defensive capacity. Defa Press also reported Deputy Talaeinezhad briefing parliament on armed forces capabilities after the "12-day war".

events.title_en: Talaeinezhad's report to parliament on the defence and support capabilities of the armed forces
events.summary_en: Budget requirements and confronting hybrid warfare were discussed in a session between parliament and the Ministry of Defence. In this session, whilst presenting a report on the conditions and developments during the 12-day war and Ramadan war, various dimensions of threats and the requirements to strengthen the country's defence capabilities, as well as the budgetary and financial needs of the armed forces, were reviewed. In this meeting, Brigadier-General Reza Talaeinezhad, Deputy for Development Management and Strategic Planning at the Ministry of Defence and Support of the Armed Forces, presented a report on the defence and support capabilities of the armed forces, requirements and budgetary necessities, the method of resource provision and reconstruction programmes.
